products.title: 90° Komatsu Female Hose Fitting (JIS Metric)
products.descriptionShort: 90° Komatsu Female (JIS Metric) — 30° cone seat, 60° included (JIS B8363), 10 sizes, -04 to -24.
products.descriptionLong:
The 90° Komatsu Female Hose Fitting (JIS Metric) is a hydraulic hose fitting with 30° cone seat, 60° included (JIS B8363).

Completes the Komatsu family — the straight male and female have been on the site, the 90° elbow had not. The seat is the same 30° cone (60° included) as the rest of the family.

Construction

  • Configuration: 90 elbow
  • Thread: M14×1.5 to M42×1.5
  • Sealing form: 30° cone seat, 60° included (JIS B8363)
  • Gender: female-swivel
  • Material: carbon steel, zinc-plated and Cr3+ passivated (316 stainless on request)

Sizes

10 sizes, -04 to -24, threads M14×1.5 to M42×1.5. The full size and dimension table is on this page.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number for the size you need. Tell us the hose grade and bore and we will include the matching crimp ferrule — the ferrule follows the hose, not the fitting. Indus crimps and pressure-tests assemblies before dispatch.

products.seoDescription: 90° Komatsu Female Hose Fitting (JIS Metric) — 10 sizes (-04 to -24), M14×1.5 to M42×1.5. Carbon steel or 316 stainless, ex-Dubai.

faqs.question: Is this a 30° cone or a 60° cone?
faqs.answer: Both names describe this seat. 30° is the angle measured from the centreline, 60° is the angle across the full cone. Our supplier uses one convention in one catalogue and the other in another, which is a common source of confusion on Japanese fittings. If a drawing or a competitor part number quotes either number for a JIS metric fitting, it is this seat.

faqs.question: What is the sealing form?
faqs.answer: 30° cone seat, 60° included (JIS B8363). Pair it with the matching counterpart — a mismatched sealing form will seat but will not hold pressure.

faqs.question: What sizes are available?
faqs.answer: 10 sizes, -04 to -24, threads M14×1.5 to M42×1.5. Every row in the table on this page is an orderable part number.

faqs.question: What is the maximum working pressure?
faqs.answer: The hose grade and bore set the assembly rating, not the fitting. A correctly crimped fitting does not derate the hose. Tell us the grade and bore on the RFQ and we will confirm the figure in writing.

faqs.question: Which ferrule pairs with this fitting?
faqs.answer: The one that matches your hose grade — the skive/no-skive choice follows the hose construction, not the fitting end. Send the hose grade with your enquiry and we will specify the ferrule and the crimp diameter.

faqs.question: Is stainless steel available?
faqs.answer: Yes — 316 stainless on request across the range. Standard supply is carbon steel, zinc-plated and Cr3+ passivated. Add "-SS" to the part number when you enquire.

faqs.question: Can Indus crimp the assembly?
faqs.answer: Yes. We crimp, pressure-test and certify assemblies in Dubai and ship UAE-wide. Send the hose grade, bore, both end fittings, overall length and orientation.

products.descriptionLong:
The JIS Gas Male 60° Cone Hose Fitting is a hydraulic hose fitting with 30° cone seat, 60° included (JIS B8363).

The male half of the JIS gas range — a BSP-form thread used on Japanese equipment, distinct from the JIS metric (Komatsu) threads in the same category. Check which thread your port carries before ordering; the two are not interchangeable.

faqs.question: How is JIS gas different from JIS metric?
faqs.answer: The thread. JIS gas uses a BSP-form parallel thread; JIS metric (the Komatsu style) uses a metric thread. The 30° cone seat (60° included) is the same on both, so the seat will look right and the thread will not fit.
